dropped_from_p3.reason: Confirmed on re-read of its own datasheet (JLCPCB C85135): section on reverse battery operation states 'the reverse load current through the intrinsic drain-source diode' flows during reverse current operation, i.e. the part conducts reverse current rather than blocking it, the same V126 (reverse blocking) failure P2 already found in TPS25946xx and TPS1663x. It also now fails the stock gate: JLCPCB stockCount 0, canPresaleNumber -25, under the 500-unit threshold this function uses. P3 named the wider Infineon PROFET/BTS family as a miss; only BTS716G, the part on the JLCPCB board, was re-checked here.

Confirmed on re-read of its own datasheet (JLCPCB C75918, passes the stock gate at 1699/1697): the electrical table gives an 'Output - VCC diode voltage' VF of 0.7 V max at -IOUT 2 A, and the absolute maximum ratings give a 12 A 'Reverse DC output current' rating. The part carries an intrinsic diode from OUT to VCC that conducts a reverse current rather than blocking it, so it fails V126 (reverse blocking) for the same reason as BTS716G, TPS25946xx and TPS1663x; its 'reverse battery protection' feature covers a reversed VCC connection, not current fed back into the rail from the port pin.
